q: Unless otherwise posted, what is the maximum speed limit on most California highways?
The handbook gives 65 mph as the maximum on most California highways unless otherwise posted.
What is the speed limit on a two-lane undivided highway in California, unless otherwise posted?
The handbook says it is 55 mph on a two-lane undivided highway and for vehicles towing trailers.
What is the speed limit within 500 feet of a school while children are outside or crossing the street?
The handbook gives 25 mph within 500 feet of a school while children are outside or crossing; some school zones may be posted as low as 15 mph.
What is the speed limit in an alley?
The handbook states that the speed limit in an alley is 15 mph.
You are within 100 feet of a railroad crossing and cannot see the tracks for 400 feet in both directions. What is the speed limit?
The handbook gives 15 mph in this situation. You may go faster if the crossing is controlled by gates, a warning signal or a flagger.
What does California's Basic Speed Law say?
You may always drive at the posted limit
You may never drive faster than is safe for current conditions
You must keep up with the fastest traffic
You may exceed the limit by 5 mph when passing
The handbook: you may never drive faster than is safe for the current road conditions. This is the Basic Speed Law.
In heavy rain you cannot see more than 100 feet ahead. According to the handbook, it is not safe to drive faster than:
The handbook says that if you cannot see farther than 100 feet, it is not safe to drive faster than 30 mph.
For a driver over 21, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
The handbook: it is illegal to drive with a BAC of 0.08% or higher if you are over 21.
For a driver under 21, it is illegal to drive with a BAC of:
The handbook gives 0.01% or higher for drivers under 21, and for a driver of any age on DUI probation.
About how far before a turn should you start signalling?
The handbook says to start signalling about 100 feet before the turn.
You may not park within how many feet of a fire hydrant?
The handbook lists within 15 feet of a fire hydrant or a fire station driveway among the places where you must not park.
When you cannot change lanes to pass a bicyclist, how much space must you leave?
The handbook: allow at least three feet between your vehicle and the bicyclist; if you cannot, do not pass until you can.
Before a turn, you may enter a bike lane no more than how far ahead?
The handbook says to enter a bike lane no more than 200 feet before starting a turn.
How far may you drive in a center left turn lane?
The handbook: you may only drive for 200 feet in the center left turn lane. It is not a regular traffic or passing lane.
On a two-lane road where passing is unsafe, you must use a turnout to let others pass when how many vehicles are following you?
The handbook says you must use a turnout area or lane when you are driving slowly and five or more vehicles are following you.
What does a red painted curb mean?
Stop only to pick up or drop off passengers
In the handbook's list of colored curbs, red means no stopping. White is for picking up or dropping off passengers, green is limited-time parking and yellow is for loading and unloading.
What does a white painted curb mean?
Stop only long enough to pick up or drop off passengers
The handbook: white means stop only long enough to pick up or drop off passengers.
At a solid red light, when may you turn right?
After stopping and yielding, unless a NO TURN ON RED sign is posted
Without stopping if the way is clear
Only when a green arrow appears
The handbook: you can turn right at a red light if there is no NO TURN ON RED sign, after you stop at the limit line and yield to pedestrians. You may not turn at a red arrow.
What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
Proceed with caution; you do not need to stop
The signal is broken; treat it as a stop sign
The handbook describes a flashing yellow light as a warning to proceed with caution: slow down and be alert; you do not need to stop.
As you approach a roundabout, who must you yield to?
The handbook: slow down as you approach and yield to all traffic already in the roundabout.
Two vehicles meet on a steep, narrow mountain road where neither can pass. Who has the right-of-way?
The handbook: the vehicle facing uphill has the right-of-way; the one facing downhill has more control when backing and should back up.
A pedestrian using a guide dog or a white cane is crossing. Who has the right-of-way?
The driver, if the light is green
The pedestrian only in a marked crosswalk
The handbook: pedestrians using guide dogs or white canes have the right-of-way at all times.
When a bus, streetcar or trolley is stopped at a safety zone, you may pass at no more than:
The handbook gives a limit of 10 mph for passing in this situation.
Which rule does the handbook give for a safe following distance?
One car length for every 20 mph
Stay close enough to read the plate
The handbook tells drivers to use the three-second rule to keep a safe following distance.
You cannot see a truck's side mirrors. What does that tell you?
The truck is about to turn
The truck driver cannot see you
It is safe to pass on the right
The truck has no blind spots
The handbook: if you cannot see the truck's side mirrors, the truck driver cannot see you. You are in a blind spot, or No Zone.
What does the handbook say about using a handheld cell phone while driving?
It is allowed for calls but not for texts
The handbook: driving while using a handheld cell phone is unsafe and illegal; adult drivers should use a phone only in hands-free mode when necessary.
When it is raining, which lights should you use?
The handbook: when it is raining, use your low-beam headlights; do not drive using only your parking lights.
How many attempts at the knowledge test are allowed before you must reapply?
The handbook says you are allowed three attempts to pass before you must reapply.
How many hours of supervised practice must a driver under 18 complete before the driving test?
The handbook: at least 50 hours with a California-licensed driver who is at least 25 years old; ten hours must be at night.
You are parking headed downhill beside a curb. Which way should the front wheels point?
Into the curb or toward the side of the road
It does not matter if the parking brake is set
The handbook: headed downhill, turn your front wheels into the curb or toward the side of the road, and set the parking brake.
In part one of the Virginia knowledge exam, how many of the ten traffic sign questions must you answer correctly?
The manual: you must correctly answer all ten traffic sign questions in part one before you can take part two.
What score is needed to pass part two of the Virginia knowledge exam?
The manual: you must answer at least 80 percent of the part two questions correctly.
If you are under 18 and fail the knowledge exam, how long must you wait before retaking it?
The manual says that by law a person under 18 must wait a full 15 days.
Unless a sign says otherwise, what is the maximum speed limit in school, business and residential areas?
The manual gives 25 MPH for school, business and residential areas, 35 MPH for unpaved roads and 55 MPH for all other roads, unless posted otherwise.
Unless a sign says otherwise, what is the maximum speed limit on unpaved roads?
The manual gives 35 MPH for unpaved roads.
At speeds under 35 MPH on a dry road, what following distance does the manual give?
The manual's table: 2 seconds under 35 MPH, 3 seconds at 35 to 45 MPH, and 4 seconds at 46 to 70 MPH.
At 46 to 70 MPH on a dry road, what following distance does the manual give?
The manual gives 4 seconds for 46 to 70 MPH, and notes that these cushions do not work above 70.
How far ahead of a turn should you signal?
Only as you begin to turn
The manual: signal at least three or four seconds, 100 feet, ahead of the turn.
A school bus is stopped with flashing red lights and its stop sign extended. You are approaching from the opposite direction on an undivided road. What must you do?
Stop and remain stopped until all persons are clear and the bus moves again
Stop, then proceed when no child is in your lane
The manual: you must stop when approaching from any direction and remain stopped until all persons are clear and the bus moves again.
When do you not have to stop for a stopped school bus with flashing red lights?
When you are in a hurry
When the bus is on the opposite side of a median or barrier
When you are driving below 15 MPH
The manual: you do not have to stop if you are travelling in the opposite direction on a roadway with a median or barrier between you and the bus. Still be ready for unexpected actions.
You may not park within how many feet of a fire hydrant?
The manual lists within 15 feet of a fire hydrant.
You may not park within how many feet of an intersection?
The manual lists within 20 feet of an intersection.
You may not park within how many feet of a railroad crossing?
The manual lists within 50 feet of a railroad crossing.
Virginia law requires headlights in bad weather when visibility is reduced to:
The manual: use headlights during inclement weather such as rain, fog, snow or sleet when visibility is reduced to 500 feet.
When must you use your headlights along with your windshield wipers?
Whenever you use the wipers because of bad weather
The manual: you must use your headlights whenever you use your windshield wipers as a result of bad weather.
When following another vehicle at night, within what distance should you use low beams?
The manual: when following, use low-beams whenever you are within 200 feet of the vehicle ahead.
For a driver aged 21 or older, the manual says you are considered to be driving under the influence if your BAC is:
The manual: .08 percent or higher. It adds that if your driving is impaired you can be convicted with a lower BAC.
A driver under 21 can be convicted of illegal consumption of alcohol with a BAC of at least:
The manual: at least .02 but less than .08. At .08 or higher the driver could be convicted of DUI.
When passing a person riding a bicycle, what does the manual tell you to do?
Sound the horn and pass closely
Reduce speed and pass at least three feet to the left
Pass on the right if there is room
The manual: reduce speed and pass at least three feet to the left.
In which direction does traffic move in a roundabout?
The manual: after entering the roundabout, drivers must travel in a counter-clockwise direction, and entering traffic must yield to pedestrians and to traffic already in the circle.
When may you turn left at a red light?
From a one-way street onto another one-way street, after stopping
From any street if no traffic is coming
The manual: you may turn left at a red light if you are on a one-way street and turning left onto another one-way street, after a complete stop.
When may you not turn right on red?
When a "No Turn on Red" sign is posted or a red arrow pointing right is displayed
On any road with two lanes
Whenever a pedestrian signal is present
The manual: you may not turn right on red if signs read "No Turn on Red" or if a red arrow pointing to the right is displayed.
What must you do at a flashing red light?
Come to a complete stop, yield, and go when the way is clear
Treat it as a yield sign
The manual: come to a complete stop and yield to oncoming vehicles and pedestrians; you may go when the way is clear.
Who must wear safety belts under Virginia law, according to the manual?
The driver and all passengers, front and rear
The manual: the driver and all passengers, both front and rear, must wear safety belts.
Someone is tailgating you. What does the manual advise?
Speed up well above the limit
Do not brake suddenly; move to another lane if possible, or gently tap your brakes
Stop on the road and wave them past
The manual: do not brake suddenly; if possible move over to another lane, or gently tap your brakes to flash your brake lights and slow down.
Which three things determine the distance it takes to stop your vehicle?
Perception time, reaction distance and braking distance
Tyre size, fuel level and gear
The manual names perception time, reaction distance and braking distance.
What does the manual say about your hand position on the steering wheel?
The manual: if the steering wheel were a clock, your hands should be at the 8 o'clock and 4 o'clock positions.
A slow moving vehicle sign is displayed by vehicles travelling at:
The manual: slow moving vehicles travelling at 25 MPH or less, such as farm equipment and horse-drawn vehicles, must display the sign on a public highway.
What colour marks a highway work zone, according to the manual?
The manual: the colour orange marks a work zone and means slow down and be alert.
From when to when must you use headlights?
Only when street lights are off
The manual: you must use headlights from sunset to sunrise.
What is the speed limit in an alley in Oregon, unless otherwise posted?
The manual lists 15 miles per hour when driving in alleys and in narrow residential areas.
What is the speed limit in any business district, unless otherwise posted?
The manual lists 20 miles per hour in any business district and within a school speed zone.
What is the speed limit in a residential district, unless otherwise posted?
The manual lists 25 miles per hour in residential districts, in public parks, and on ocean shores where vehicles are permitted.
What is the speed limit on roads and highways that fit no other category, unless otherwise posted?
The manual lists 55 miles per hour on all roads and highways not meeting any other definition unless otherwise posted. Interstate limits vary.
What reduced speed applies in a school speed zone?
The manual: a school speed zone is an area where a reduced speed of 20 mph applies, defined by school speed signs.
When moving in traffic, how far before a turn or lane change must you signal?
The manual: use your turn signal at least 100 feet before the turn or lane change.
When may you use hand-and-arm signals instead of turn signal lights?
Only in daylight and when people and vehicles are clearly visible at 1,000 feet
The manual: only use hand-and-arm signals in daylight and when you can clearly see people and vehicles at a distance of 1,000 feet. Signal lights must be used at night or in poor visibility.
How does the manual define a safe following distance?
The manual: a safe following distance is defined as 2 to 4 seconds.
At speeds above 30 mph, a safe following distance should be:
The manual: for speeds greater than 30 mph, a safe following distance should be 4 seconds or more.
You may not park within how many feet of a fire hydrant?
The manual lists within 10 feet of a fire hydrant.
You may not park within how many feet of a marked or unmarked crosswalk at an intersection?
The manual lists within 20 feet of a marked or unmarked crosswalk at an intersection.
You may not park within how many feet of the driveway entrance to a fire station, on the same side of the street?
The manual: within 15 feet on the same side of the street, or within 75 feet on the opposite side.
When must headlights be turned on?
The manual: headlights must be turned on from sunset to sunrise.
Headlights must also be on at any time conditions make it difficult to see people or vehicles how far ahead?
The manual: lights must be on at any time conditions make it difficult to see people or vehicles 1,000 feet ahead.
Using high beams, you must dim your lights when an oncoming vehicle is within:
The manual: dim your lights when an oncoming vehicle is within 500 feet.
You must dim your lights when following another vehicle within:
The manual: dim your lights when following another vehicle within 350 feet.
Which headlight beam should you use in fog, dust or smoke?
The manual: use headlights on low beam; light from high beams reflects back and causes glare.
What does the manual say about cell phone use by drivers under 18?
It is allowed with a hands-free accessory
It is illegal to use a cell phone or other mobile electronic device while operating a vehicle
It is allowed for calls under one minute
It is allowed on rural roads
The manual: it is illegal for drivers under 18 to use a cell phone or other mobile electronic device while operating a vehicle.
How may a driver aged 18 or older use a cell phone while driving?
Held in the hand, for calls only
The manual: drivers 18 or older must use a hands-free accessory, which must need only minimal use of a finger to activate or deactivate.
At what blood alcohol concentration does Oregon law presume that you are impaired?
The manual: at 0.08% or more Oregon law presumes you are impaired, but you can still be arrested with a lower BAC.
Under Oregon's open container law, when is a container of alcohol considered open?
Only when it is being drunk from
When its seal is broken, even if it has been reclosed
Only when it is less than half full
Only when it has no cap
The manual: a container is considered open if its seal is broken, even if it has been reclosed. Keep such containers in the trunk.
At an intersection controlled by a traffic signal, unless a sign permits it
On any road with a centre line
The manual lists intersections controlled by a traffic signal, unless a sign permits the turn, among the places where U-turns are prohibited.
Within city limits, a U-turn is prohibited where your vehicle cannot be seen by traffic from either direction within:
The manual: 500 feet within city limits, and 1,000 feet outside city limits.
What does a flashing yellow arrow mean?
You may make the turn after yielding to pedestrians and oncoming traffic
Oncoming traffic must stop for you
The manual: you may make the movement shown by the arrow, but first you must yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic, which has a steady green signal.
A vehicle is following you too closely and there is a right lane. What does the manual suggest?
The manual: if a vehicle behind you is following too closely and there is a right lane, move over to the right.
A transit bus signals to re-enter traffic and an electric "yield" sign is flashing on its back. What must vehicles approaching from the rear do?
Stop until the sign goes off
The manual: vehicles approaching from the rear must yield when a bus driver signals to re-enter a traffic lane and the yield sign is flashing.
When you are required to dim your headlights, what must you do with auxiliary lights such as fog lights?
Use them in place of headlights
The manual: when you are required to dim your headlights, other auxiliary lights such as fog lights must be off.
Only when other vehicles are close
Before you turn, change lanes, exit a roundabout or pull away from a curb
The manual: you must signal before you turn, change lanes, exit a roundabout, or pull away from a curb.
What is a speed limit, according to the manual?
The speed you must always drive at
The maximum speed considered safe for the area under ideal driving conditions
A suggestion that police do not enforce
The manual: a speed limit is the maximum speed considered safe for the area under ideal driving conditions.
You must stop and stay stopped for pedestrians crossing:
Only where a signal tells you to
The manual: stop and stay stopped for pedestrians crossing in marked or unmarked crosswalks.
